texts.Feature:Metrics.Description: Prepares numbers on orders and trips and lets a connected AI tool ask for them: totals, breakdowns and definitions. The tools also need the AI connector to be on.
texts.Reporting:Setting.BackfillCompletedAtDes: When this tenant's numbers were first fully prepared. Until then the metric tools answer that they are not ready.
texts.Reporting:Setting.BackfillPositionDescri: How far preparing this tenant's numbers has come.
texts.Reporting:Setting.RepairLastRunAtDescrip: When the daily repair of this tenant's numbers last finished.
